title: RwLockExt Trait
description: Extension trait for RwLock that panics on poisoning rather than returning an error.
signature: pub trait RwLockExt<T: ?Sized> { fn read_or_panic(&self) -> RwLockReadGuard<'_, T>; fn write_or_panic(&self) -> RwLockWriteGuard<'_, T>; }
semantics: Treats a poisoned lock as a fatal invariant violation, consistent with STANDARDS.md section 5.
